seo.title: Quick Checklist — Free Personal Notes, To-Do List & Checklist App
seo.description: A free online checklist app and to-do list maker with no sign-up. Write quick notes, build a digital checklist, and stay organised — everything stays private on your own device and works offline.

landing.heroTitle: Personal notes and to-do lists that stay yours.
landing.heroBody: A free personal notes app and checklist maker — no account, no sign-up. Everything is stored in your own browser; nothing is ever sent to a server.

features.privacyBody: Your notes live in your own browser's storage. They never touch a server unless you one day pay us to sync them.
features.checklistBody: Capture starts as a checklist, and checklists are unlimited — on every plan.
features.autoEntryBody: Start typing and it finishes the phrase for you, learned from your own past tasks — press Tab to accept.

landing.altTo: Free forever, no ads, no login, and it works offline — a lighter alternative to Todoist, Google Keep, or Notion when all you want is a fast checklist and to-do list app.

editor.none: Select a note, or write a new one.

reminders.bestEffortNote: Without an account, reminders fire only while the app is open. Reliable notifications on every device arrive with sync.
